src.gen: An elderly Asian Buddhist monk with a shaved head, wearing saffron and orange temple robes, standing in an ancient stone courtyard in China at dawn, mist drifting past red wooden pillars
src.move: the monk slowly bows his head, then opens his eyes and looks up

src.gen: A home dining room, empty plates on a wooden table, a stand-in host in a dark sweater sitting across from an Asian Buddhist monk in orange robes, warm evening lamp light
src.move: the monk shakes his head and gestures with an open hand while he speaks

src.gen: A small Chinese restaurant booth lit by red lanterns, a round table crowded with a bowl of vegetable noodle soup, a plate of stir-fried vegetables and a plate of vegetable fried rice, chopsticks resting on the bowls
src.move: steam rises from the bowl of noodle soup as chopsticks lift a few vegetables

src.gen: A dinner table at night lit by candlelight, a thick grilled steak on a white plate in front of an Asian Buddhist monk in orange robes, a fork and knife in his hands
src.move: the monk lifts a forkful of steak to his mouth and smiles while chewing
